title: ci(pm): `check:pm-dispatch-gates` is red on main — its live-tree case reads `mkdtempSync(join(process.cwd(), …))` in a #22365 dogfood test as an unresolved temp base
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing.** A repo gate is red on `main` and on every PR whose run reaches it. `reach:` the `Lint & Repo Gates` job, step "PM dispatch-gates self-test", measured. Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549, `session_01DhTqaEHqPVSVnAkjG3jywn`) from two dev reports and the CI readings below. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What is red

`pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` fails 1 of 2011 self-test cases. The failing case reads:

> `no mkdtempSync site in this tree takes a base the scan cannot read — UNRESOLVED: packages/qa/dogfood/test/security-catalog-cold-boot-environment-holder.dogfood.test.ts:108 (process.cwd())`

- The case is at `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:26841`. It runs over the LIVE tree, the half that, in the code's own comment, "a fifth fixture author's PR reds on".
- The site is `const databaseFile = () => join(mkdtempSync(join(process.cwd(), 'catalog-cold-boot-')), 'deployment.db');`, which arrived with PR #22365 (`e030d436b`, #22307). The file's header explains why it uses the per-file working directory (#21914).

## Where it was read red

- `main`: `e75dceddd`, `Lint & Repo Gates` job `113666891682`, step 35, failure at 2026-10-09T04:29Z.
- PR #22381 at `f7f6a2e09` (job `113637807561`) and PR #22396 at `8d9dcbb40` (job `113641401005`): the same step, the same 1-of-2011 count.
- Reproduced locally by #11509's dev at `b1f7a7a73`, with the case text quoted above.
- Some `main` runs after `e030d436b` were green on this job (`d8d071117`, `ac8f2c560`). Whether the step is path-scheduled was not measured. Every run that reached the step since `e030d436b` and was read went red.

## The question for the owner

Two landings are possible, and triage picks the lane:
- **(a) The test site.** Give `mkdtempSync` a base the scan can read, while keeping the per-file working directory that the file's header relies on. The file is in `packages/qa/dogfood` (`domain:cli`), and was authored under #22307 (`domain:engine`).
- **(b) The scan.** Teach `exposedScratchDirs` to resolve a `process.cwd()` base for files that run under the dogfood per-file cwd, so the scan reads the site instead of reporting it unresolved. The scan is in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (PM tooling).

Either way, the case's purpose stays: a temp root inside the tree must be covered by a tracked ignore rule.

**Who waits:** PR #22381 (#22301 stage 2), PR #22396 (#22258), and any PR whose `Lint & Repo Gates` run reaches step 35.

Dedupe: REST search over open issues for `mkdtempSync` and for `"dispatch-gates" self-test`: 0 hits.
